paragraphs: R' Yishmael the Elder, son-in-law of R' Chanina.
Mentioned in Berakhot 22b according to Dikdukei Soferim's reading, reporting in the name of R' Chanina; the same reading appears in Yalkut on Samuel, remez 136.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Saba is lexically elder or grandfather, but this syntax naturally gives the epithet Elder followed by son-in-law of Chanina. The older grandfather-of-son-in-law proposal would more naturally require a linking d- and is not adopted. This is a grammatical reading, not a newly verified family identity.

דק״ס is contextually Dikdukei Soferim, the source of a reading rather than a speaker. The headed Yishmael is the implicit reporter. כב:/קלו give 22b/136 without a fresh collation or added Shimoni/edition. All three title abbreviations remain R'.
